parts.premise:
1. The homework ranges by grade come from a parent guide, not a study.
2. The National PTA and NEA guide caps grades K–2 at 10 to 20 minutes a day. It says grades 3–6 can handle 30 to 60 minutes.
3. Educators often call the PTA and NEA ranges the Ten Minute Rule (Cooper, 2001). The part of the guide Cooper quotes gives ranges, not a formula.
parts.hypothesis: Guidelines recommend 10 minutes of homework for kindergarten students.
